intro_body: Every TrueNorth house will be a real home on a real street — not a facility. Small by design, so nobody disappears into the crowd.
empty_title: Our first house is opening soon.
empty_body: We're getting the first TrueNorth house ready in North Texas right now. If you or someone you love is looking for a bed, get on the list — we're filling it in the order people reach out, and we'll call you the moment a room is ready.
prelaunch_pill: Now taking applications for our first house

homes.name: PLACEHOLDER — Your first house
homes.description: PLACEHOLDER — Two or three sentences describing the house the way you'd describe it to a friend. What the building is like, how many people live there, and what one true thing makes it different. Flip 'Show on website' to Yes once this is real and the doors are open.
